{{Quote|Explanation: You see, master, assassination is such a versatile tool. I have seen the removal of a single target have far-reaching consequences for a nation, world, even a galaxy. The repercussions of even the smallest lives&hellip; whether dead or alive, can have profound implications on history.|[[HK-47]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Assassins''' were beings or machines trained to [[Death/Legends|kill other beings]], either for [[Mercenary/Legends|hire]] or for [[Politics/Legends|political]] gain.

==Characteristics==
[[File:DarthMaul-DPback.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] served as an assassin for Darth Sidious and Darth Plagueis]]
Members of the profession were referred to by many euphemisms and epithets: "problem solvers" in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], "exterminators" in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and "slayers" in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="GG11" /> Whatever their name, most professional assassins were concerned solely with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], though some killed for political or religious reasons, or merely for love of killing. This made assassins simultaneously the best-paid and most-despised members of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] underworld.

A large number of the assassins operating in the galaxy had a cover identity, often working in fields that gave them a reason to travel. This helped them to establish an alibi for why they were in a location at the time of an assassination if they were ever caught. Many worked as [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], sales representatives, or even [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Assassins generally used the same method to kill their targets, establishing it as a "signature" of their work. Some used a particular type of weapon, others always used a similar method of entry to get close to their prey.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

Though assassination was illegal on most planets, on some, such as [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], assassinations were part of society.

Many [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who had no objections to killing their targets or working for criminals straddled the line between assassin and bounty hunter.

===Types of assassins===
Orders of assassins in the galaxy included the [[Assassin's Guild/Legends|Assassin's Guild]], the [[Fpi Assassins]], the [[Loag]], the [[Malkite Poisoners]], and the [[GenoHaradan]].

While assassins could come from a variety of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], some species were disproportionately represented in the profession. These included [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]], [[Night-Soarer|Tyluun Night-Soarers]], [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestians]], [[Bartokk]], [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], and [[Blood Carver]]s.
[[File:Clawdite_assassin.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] assassin targeting an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer]]
[[Droid/Legends|Droids]] built to kill, such as [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]], [[HK-47]], [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], and [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]], were known as [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]].

[[Clone assassin]]s were specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] trained to kill Jedi with the art of Teras Kasi.

[[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] were [[Sith Minion|minions]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who specialized in stealth and infiltration in order to kill the enemies of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]].

[[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunters]] were assassins who specialized in killing Jedi. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Galen Marek]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] were well-known Jedi hunters, the last playing a major part in the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Many Jedi hunters were Sith; many others were simply skilled combatants with a hatred for the Jedi.

[[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] would almost always kill for [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]], although some captured living people. Hunters such as [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] were sometimes referred to as assassins.
